reviews.title: Scammed into paying more like many others
reviews.text:
I never activated my premium subscription because according to the sketchy support, I had signed up through the website and not through the app.

The app therefore doesn’t show me any premium content and still asks me to subscribe. I asked for a refund for a subscription that had been charged twice but never activated - same as everyone else, they can’t possibly give a refund, even for a product they can see I have never been able to consume. I didn’t even know I had signed up for the premium subscription until I saw the charges. 

Avoid giving these people your payment details. Sketchy AF. If your default answer to disappointed customers is “you didn’t read the terms properly” then your terms are deliberately designed to hide something. Disingenuous and downright shady.
reviews.reply:

reviews.title: Maliciously forced & misleading charging
reviews.text:
Long story short - like many other users, I went to check the app while there was a free reading advertised. To see the results of the “freee reading” you had to download the app and log in with Apple account. As I saw that subscription costs 39€, I never finalised the subscription. Just in case checked, since ai used Apple account while loging in, if it appears under “My subscriptions” it didn’t. And then, a couple of weeks later i suddenly get charged of 39€! 
I check again under Apple account, if I’m crazy, where my subscription is - there isn’t one! So I contacted Nebula - and they still confirm, that I have subscribed :( I just feel cheated.
reviews.reply: Hello, your feedback is very important to us as it helps us to grow so we can provide you with better service! We’re truly sorry for the confusion and frustration this has caused. Your trust matters to us, and we believe in keeping things transparent. That’s why we always provide clear and complete details about the service and any future payments if applicable right on the offer screen. And since we got in contact — let`s rock it up together! Please email us at support-appstore@asknebula.com so we can investigate further and help resolve this for you. Kindest regards, Nebula team 🔮
